look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: a design-vs-live split showing drift, a pile of small uncommitted changes, a dbd diff report, a red CI pipeline gate, a green fixed check, and the dbd end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.
